qa_pairs.question: What should you always disconnect when working on the electrical system for TCI and DME?
qa_pairs.answer: Always disconnect battery or interrupt power supply to ignition control unit and ignition coil when working on the electrical system.

qa_pairs.question: Why is it dangerous to work on the ignition system while connected to power?
qa_pairs.answer: It's dangerous due to primary and secondary voltage as well as danger of destroying the ignition system.

qa_pairs.question: What should you never do after removing the distributor cap or disconnecting wire on ignition coil term. 4?
qa_pairs.answer: Never start the engine after removal of distributor cap and/or disconnection of wire on ignition coil term. 4 - pull off plug on ignition control unit.

qa_pairs.question: Can you disconnect the battery while the engine is running?
qa_pairs.answer: Never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter while engine is running.

qa_pairs.question: What type of parts should be used for replacement on the ignition system?
qa_pairs.answer: Only install specified original BMW parts.

qa_pairs.question: What should you never connect to ignition coil term. 1?
qa_pairs.answer: Never connect a shielded capacitor or test lamp on term. 1 of the ignition coil.

qa_pairs.question: How should ignition coil term. 1 wire be handled regarding grounding?
qa_pairs.answer: Never connect wire of ignition coil term. 1 on ground or B+. Consequently the ignition coil term. 1 wire must not be used to prevent engine starting when service installing a burglar alarm system.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the shielded resistor in the distributor rotor?
qa_pairs.answer: The original distributor rotor with 1 k-ohm shielded resistor provides the minimum required shielding for the secondary (high voltage) side of the ignition system.
